forms.name: 中国K12反馈素养｜反馈知识无分反思｜教师自评｜2025英文公开题文
forms.instruction: These statements come from a teacher feedback-giving literacy study. For each statement, you may describe an example, a learning need or a question. You can leave any statement unanswered or decline to answer. No ratings, scores, levels or automated judgements are produced. This is a project reflection form, not the original validated questionnaire; the original teacher response anchors and scoring instructions have not been verified. Your perspective does not establish the feedback students actually received. Do not include student names or identifiable work. © The Author(s) 2025 (Cui Kang, Jinyan Huang, Ying Liu, Hua Yin). CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Original English item text reproduced from Tables 2–3 of https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-025-04927-4. These are author-created items; no separate restrictive credit line accompanies the tables. Project changes: four standalone unscored reflection forms, optional long-text answers, instructions and independently drafted Simplified Chinese working translations. Neither an author-endorsed digital questionnaire nor a validated Chinese/English standalone scale is claimed. No participant datasets, article layout, images or supplement charts are redistributed.

forms.instruction: 下列陈述来自教师反馈素养研究，中文为项目工作译文，不是原研究正式中文版。请任选陈述，描述一个实例、学习需要或疑问；可以留空或拒答。不填等级、不计分、不生成能力评语。这是项目改编的无分反思表单，原教师作答选项和计分说明尚未核得。自我认识不能证明学生实际收到的反馈质量。请勿填写学生姓名或可识别的作业信息。 来源：Kang、Huang、Liu、Yin（2025），DOI 10.1057/s41599-025-04927-4，表2–3；原作者CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/。改动：拆分、可选文字反思、项目指导语和中文工作翻译；不表示原作者认可。
